description: Central Province - Notifying that Mr. Gamini Ellepola, has resigned from the membership and appointed Mr. M. A. Edmund Mahendra as a member of the Director Board of the Central Province Passenger Transport Services Authority w.e.f. 05.08.2016
categorisation: This gazette content focuses exclusively on government personnel changes - specifically the dissolution and appointment of named individuals (Mr. Gamini Ellepola and Mr. M. A. Edmund Mahendra) to the Director Board of the Central Province Passenger Transport Services Authority. While it mentions the minister's portfolio, it does not provide detailed descriptions of portfolio responsibilities or subject matter areas for the individuals being appointed/dissolved. The content centers on the personnel actions (resignation and new appointment) rather than structural changes or detailed portfolio assignments.
